items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: A phone. I can talk to people with it.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: There's an office for people who wake up with abilities. I found it before you arrived.

items.speaker: NIB
items.text: They know how to send me back?

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: I don't know. They know more than I do.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: I awakened yesterday. The class said summoner. I'd like an assessment.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: He talks. He wants to go back.

items.speaker: STAFF, PHONE
items.text: I'll note that for the assessor. We need to see you in person.

items.speaker: STAFF, PHONE
items.text: Can you come at eleven? Bring your identification, and bring him with you.

items.speaker: STAFF, PHONE
items.text: I'll send the address. Don't try anything new before the appointment.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: Keep that in its sheath outside.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: Eleven o'clock. I'm Taeo. This is Nib.

items.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
items.text: Take a seat. The assessor will call you.

items.speaker: REPORTER, TV
items.text: Will your team go back in today?

items.speaker: SEORYUN, TV
items.text: The next team is already there. Mine are going home to sleep.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: No. I've watched her for years.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: There was a rescue on the news when I was younger. She kept going back for people.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: They showed the families waiting outside. Then people started coming out.

items.speaker: ASSESSOR
items.text: I'm Chae. I'll be doing your assessment.

items.speaker: CHAE
items.text: The call note says your summon spoke.

items.speaker: CHAE
items.text: Have a seat wherever you're comfortable.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: A gate opened at work. After we got outside, I saw the class message.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: At home there was one draw. I used it, and he appeared.
lines: was one draw. I used it,

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: His name. Goblin scout. Nothing else that I saw.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: I couldn't bring it back up. I tried last night.

items.speaker: CHAE
items.text: We'll look at that together. Don't force it now.

items.speaker: CHAE
items.text: Put your hand flat on this. Keep it there until I say.

items.speaker: CHAE
items.text: That's one measurement. I'm not assigning your rank yet.

items.speaker: CHAE
items.text: His responses don't match what I'd expect from an ordinary summon. I need to assess you together.

items.speaker: NIB
items.text: Does that tell you where I came from?

items.speaker: CHAE
items.text: No. It only measures his output.

items.speaker: CHAE
items.text: I don't know yet. Where would you be going?

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: I think he came from a dungeon. He didn't recognize—

items.speaker: CHAE
items.text: Then let's start with you. What were you doing before you arrived here?

items.speaker: NIB
items.text: Yes. Someone was coming to take over.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: What do you need us to do?

items.speaker: CHAE
items.text: First, I'll check whether I can detect a connection between you. It may help us understand how he got here.

items.speaker: CHAE
items.text: Taeo, that mark. Nib, over here.
